prTitle: feat(kotlin): add newsletter subscription billing service
prDescription:
Adds a Kotlin/Maven service under `kotlin/` that bills newsletter subscribers once per period.

- Charges each subscriber through the payment gateway at their plan's price and records an invoice per subscriber per period; subscribers already invoiced for the period are skipped.
- Declined charges mark the subscriber `past_due`.
- Billing runs on a schedule (`BILLING_RUN_INTERVAL_MINUTES`).

summary.pr_purpose: Adds a Kotlin service that bills newsletter subscribers once per period. It charges each confirmed subscriber at their plan's price and records an invoice per subscriber per period, skipping subscribers already invoiced. A declined charge marks the subscriber past_due. Billing also starts from a scheduled run.
